Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played using this card's inherited effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 4000 DP or lower Digimon card with the [Iliad] trait or [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits from your hand without paying the cost.
